feeds.title: Handmade by Carolyn
feeds.description: Carolyn shares thoughts on sewing, knitting, and looking her best. She lives in Perth, Western Australia, and makes her own clothes.

feeds.title: Sew Tessuti Blog
feeds.description: Established in 1992 and with locations in Sydney and Melbourne, Tessuti Fabrics is home to the world's most beautiful designer fabrics. Here you will find Sewing Tips & Tutorials.

feeds.title: The Craft of Clothes
feeds.description: I'm Liz Haywood. I trained as a clothing patternmaker here in Australia and worked in the fashion industry for twenty years, mainly ladies wear. I was fortunate to work at many interesting places with talented, inspiring people. Now I live in the country with my young family, where I'm re-discovering sewing for pleasure. In my blog I hope to share, inform and entertain on all things about sewing and fashion.

feeds.title: Sew Darn Tired
feeds.description: A record of my fabric and pattern collection (which I sometimes use) and what I do with any spare time I have. I love to sew, love to travel and do as much of both as I can but am doing less of both and not the level I'd like but that's life.

feeds.title: PedlarCreative
feeds.description: Well I love sewing and crafts and I would like to share that with other's who are like minded. I'm hoping to include little bits of information and tips that you may find useful, sewing tutorials, other little craft projects that I'm working on. Eventually I'm hoping create some of my own bag patterns. With so many bags in my closet and the unlimited inspiration gained from the internet and social media sites. I'm hoping to make designs which are functional, stylish and unique.

feeds.title: He Cooks… She Sews!
feeds.description: My mum was a great sewer but I didn't really get interested until high school. After that I sewed an awful lot for myself, plus one or two wedding dresses and bridesmaids dresses for family members (bad idea!). I kept sewing for myself right up to my first child. I could have up to date European fashions even though I was the other side of the world in Adelaide, Australia….

feeds.title: Molly and Mama Blog
feeds.description: Inspired by all things whimsical and pretty, Lauren from Molly and Mama has a passion for encouraging makers of all abilities on their creative journey. She enjoys sharing her love for traditional sewing techniques like embroidery, quilting, English paper piecing, appliqué, and felt sewing, in a fresh and fun way. You can see more in her beginner-friendly patterns, tutorials, and sewing club here.

feeds.title: Sewing Gem Blog
feeds.description: Online sewing store with a wide range of Fabrics, Haberdashery, Patterns and Sewing Kits. Australian based. Great prices. Made by sewers. Wide range of Fabrics, Haberdashery, Patterns and Sewing Kits. Australian based. Great prices.

feeds.title: Anne Whalley Blog
feeds.description: Anne Whalley is a fabric, sewing and pattern specialist who is passionate about helping people dress to express themselves & help them choose the wardrobe they need for their next step in life. In this blog, you will find expert advice from Anne for a complete wardrobe makeover according to your lifestyle.

feeds.title: Pants Magic
feeds.description: Personal style, dressmaking, history of fashion - these are what I know and glad to share. I am doing custom-made trousers and personal style consulting in South Brisbane, QLD. We do custom-made trousers and personal style consulting. My goal is to capture your unique story and personality and express it in every pair of pants.

feeds.title: Sew Busy Lizzy
feeds.description: In a former professional life I was once a craft magazine editor (amongst other things along the way). It used to be my job to make stuff, write about making stuff, write instructions, attend photo shoots, interview clever craftspeople. Sew Busy Lizzy is my story about me figuring out how to enjoy to MAKE THINGS again after getting married and figuring out life.

feeds.title: Fabric Tragic
feeds.description: Hey there, I'm Sarah and I live in Melbourne, Australia and I sew (a lot, stripes seem to feature a lot), I knit (slowly but evenly I am told) and I take a lot of photos of cats and houseplants....
